Promotions — one list for every offer
Card artwork — upload and live preview
Promotion detail — stats, budget, live preview

annotations.text:
THE TILE

225 x 675 — the width is exactly a third of the height. Five fit a 1192px row with 16px gaps and three pixels to spare.

HEAD, 3:8 (600px). Either an uploaded portrait image, or a generated composition centred like a poster: a tone-on-tone diamond lattice over a top glow, a seal, a kicker, then the amount in Oswald under one gold gradient clipped to the text, its bevel and glow from two drop shadows.

FOOT, 75px. The player's own progress, or the single action worth a button. Always system-drawn, so uploading artwork never costs you personalisation.

One metal for the whole family, like a tournament set. Variety comes from the artwork, not from five competing accent colours.

Five per row, and the row is a carousel: arrows beside the section link, dots underneath, more offers on the next page. On phones the same tile drops to 168 wide and shows two and a peek.

The expiry bar sits above the carousel and out of the card set. It is player state, not an offer, so it is never artwork.

The promotions page uses the same tile in a two-up grid rather than one tile per screen.

The artwork here is drawn placeholder standing in for an uploaded asset. Figures are sample values and the copy is English only.

ARTWORK UPLOAD

One portrait image per promotion at 3:8, 750 x 2000 or larger. The same file is used at every width — scaled, never re-cropped — so no separate mobile asset.

Anything that is not 3:8 is refused rather than cropped. A crop on a portrait card eats the headline and the admin never sees it happen.

The preview renders the real tile at real size beside the generated fallback, so removing an image has a visible consequence before it is removed. Carousel position is set here too.

This needs an artwork field and alt text per promotion plus the existing upload storage. The welcome bonus is a site setting today, so it has nothing to hang an image on.

The list's old hero flag is now a real artwork column: a thumbnail when one is uploaded, a Generated tag when not.

Cashback pays at period close on these screens, not at the first hourly run that sees the threshold crossed. The numbers assume it.

The three lower screens show the content area only. The sidebar is the one drawn on the list screen above.

Balance adjustment on the player Bonuses tab sits in the admin scope. It is reachable by clerks today, with no cap and no record of who did it.
